name: Curried Eggless Salad Sandwich with Spring Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spring mix if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)
¼ small bunch green onions (scallions)
¼ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ pint grape tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince (or press) the garlic into a medium salad bowl.
Add the mustard, maple syrup, olive oil, balsamic, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the garlic. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
Dijon mustard
2 tsp pure maple syrup
2 tsp balsamic vinegar
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve the grape tomatoes and set aside.
Shave the leaves off parsley stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Trim off and discard the ends of the green onions; cut the onions crosswise into ¼-inch pieces and set both aside.
Halve and pit avocado, scoop flesh out into a medium bowl and mash with a fork  Add Dijon, curry powder, turmeric, cayenne, nutritional yeast, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ avocado
Dijon mustard
1 tsp curry powder
1 pinch cayenne pepper
⅛ cup nutritional yeast flakes
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Drain tofu. Transfer to paper towels and gently pat dry. Using your hands, crumble tofu into the bowl with the avocado mixture.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (340 g) pkg extra firm tofu

instructions.primary_message: Add parsley and green onion to bowl with the tofu and avocado, stir to combine.
Assemble the sandwiches by arranging several leaves of the spring mix on half the bread slices and topping with equal portions of the tofu salad and a second slice of bread.
Mix remaining spring mix with the dressing and tomatoes.
To serve, arrange a sandwich on each plate with the salad on the side. Enjoy!
